column1: # One case a line: name, exit code, stdout, stderr, arguments (tab-separated; the arguments
# split at spaces). The binary runs in this directory. `{out}` is a report path in a scratch
# directory and `{scratch}` that directory. stdout is `golden` (the bytes of
# (expected/<name>.stderr) or `any` (some text). A case writes the report
# expected/<name>.json where that file exists and no report where it does not.
